subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Three nights in Beijing and two in Xi’an at local 5-star hotels. See Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Juyongguan Great Wall, the Terracotta Army and the Ancient City Wall, with a private coach and English-speaking guide. Flights are with Air China.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 21–26 2026 to Nov 28–Dec 3 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Beijing
items: Visit the Water Cube and the Bird’s Nest (outside view).
Visit a tea shop and Wangfujing Walking Street.
Transfer to hotel and check in. Meals: X/L/X.

itinerary.title: Beijing
items: Visit Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City.
Optional tour: Panda House at Beijing Zoo. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Beijing
items: Optional tour: Summer Palace. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Beijing – Xi’an
items: Fly Beijing to Xi’an (CA1205 20:15/22:25); meet the guide at the airport and transfer to hotel. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Xi’an
items: Explore the Ancient City Wall and No.1 Bridge.
Visit the Terracotta Army (battery bus included).
After dinner, transfer back to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Xi’an – Beijing – Manila
items: Visit Big Wild Goose Pagoda, Bell Tower and Bell and Drum Tower Square.
Fly Xi’an to Beijing (CA1210 14:00/16:10), then Beijing to Manila (CA179 19:30/00:20+1). Meals: B/L/X.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The National Aquatics Center built for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium, famous for its steel-lattice design, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: A vast public square in the heart of Beijing beside the Forbidden City entrance.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace complex in central Beijing, now a museum.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known Great Wall pass north of Beijing set in a mountain gorge.
placeDesc.Qianmen old street: A restored traditional shopping street south of Tiananmen Square with old shops and eateries.
placeDesc.Xi’an Ancient City Wall: The well-preserved Ming-era city wall around Xi’an's old centre, visited with the No.1 Bridge stop.
placeDesc.Terracotta Army: Thousands of life-size clay soldiers buried with China's first emperor; a battery bus is included.
placeDesc.Great Tang All Day Mall: A Tang-dynasty-themed shopping and entertainment complex in Xi’an.
placeDesc.Big Wild Goose Pagoda: A historic Buddhist pagoda in Xi’an dating from the Tang dynasty.
placeDesc.Bell Tower: A Ming-dynasty tower at the centre of Xi’an, visited with the Bell and Drum Tower Square.
